description: This file defines configuration options and validation logic for the Activation Repartitioner component within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes a class with configurable properties, default values, and an internal validator class that enforces constraints on these options.

classes.name: ActivationRepartitionerOptions
classes.description: Holds configurable parameters for the activation repartitioning process, such as edge counts, timing intervals, filtering settings, and error tolerances.

methods.name: ActivationRepartitionerOptionsValidator
methods.description: Validates the set of options to ensure they conform to required constraints before use.
